unitTitle: Adjectives/Order of Adjectives/Comparisons - Expressing Certainty - Will

pairsWith.noteUz: Qiyoslash mashqlari: qarama-qarshi sifatlar, than/the, yosh masalasi, shahar/qishloq dialogi, as ... as.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 3-UNIT MAShQLAR (16-bet, PDF 15). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '3'.

CHAP USTUN:
2) 'Complete the following sentences using an opposite adjective in comparative or superlative form, as in the example.' 1 I live nearer the school than you. No, you don't. You live further. (far) 2 The Porshe is faster than the Ferrari. No, it's not. It's ...... (slow) 3 Malcolm is the tallest in the class. No, he isn't. He's ...... (short) 4 My exercises were worse than yours. No, they weren't. They were ...... (good) 5 He bought the cheapest computer on the market. No, he didn't. He bought ...... (expensive) 6 The weather today is hotter than yesterday. No, it isn't. It's ...... (cold) 7 Ann is the strongest girl I know. No, she isn't. She's ...... (weak)
3) 'Put the adjectives in brackets into the correct form. Fill in than or the where necessary.' 1 My brother is ...... my sister. (short) 2 These students are very ...... (clever) 3 That is ...... train I've ever been on. (fast) 4 A piano is much ...... a guitar. (heavy) 5 Jake's is ...... restaurant in the city. (good) 6 Leslie has got ...... clothes ...... Casey. (many) 7 Picasso's paintings are very ...... (expensive) 8 Living in a flat is ...... living in a house. (cheap)
4) 'Read the following and answer the questions below.' Jean has two sisters, Mandy and Susan, and two brothers, Pete and John. Mandy is sixteen. Susan is five years younger than Mandy but she is three years older than John. John is five years younger than Jean and he is six years younger than Pete. 1 How old is Jean? (13) 2 Is Pete the oldest in the family? 3 Is Susan older than Jean? 4 Who is the youngest in the family? 5 Is Mandy older than Jean?

O'NG USTUN:
5) 'Fill in the gaps with the correct form of the adjective in brackets.' SURAT: chapda shahar (binolar, quyosh), o'ngda qishloq (uylar, o'rmon). A: Jim and I decided to move to the country. B: Really! Why is that? A: Living in the country is 1) ...... (quiet) than living in the city. The city is very 2) ...... (noisy). B: Yes, that's true. However, living in a small town isn't as 3) ...... (interesting) as living in a big city. A: Yes, you're right. Living in the country may be 4) ...... (boring) but at least life is much 5) ...... (peaceful). B: And it's also 6) ...... (healthy) I suppose because there is no pollution. Do the kids want to move to the country? A: Actually, we are moving to the country for the children. Small towns are 7) ...... (safe) than large cities.
6) 'Make comparisons using as ... as or not as ... as, as in the example.' 1 Eating fruit and vegetables is healthier than eating chocolate. Eating chocolate is not as healthy as eating fruit and vegetables. 2 I can write quicker than you. You can't write as quickly as I can. 3 Dolphins are more intelligent than whales. Whales are ...... 4 Spain and Greece are both very hot in the summer. Spain is ...... 5 Travelling by plane is faster than going by train. Going by train is ...... 6 Playing basketball is more exciting than collecting stamps. Collecting stamps is ...... 7 Josh's brother is cleverer than he is. Josh is ......

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '16'.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the following sentences using an opposite adjective in comparative or superlative form, as in the example. Example: I live nearer the school than you. - No, you don't. You live further. (far)
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni qarama-qarshi sifatning qiyosiy yoki orttirma shakli bilan to'ldiring, namunadagidek. Namuna: I live nearer the school than you. - No, you don't. You live further. (far)
exercises.explanationUz:
QARAMA-QARShI SIFAT - BIR XIL
  DARAJA.

  Birinchi gapda qiyosiy → javob
  ham qiyosiy; orttirma → orttirma.

  1 nearer → FURTHER (NAMUNA)
  2 faster → SLOWER
  3 the tallest → THE SHORTEST
  4 worse → BETTER
  5 the cheapest → THE MOST
    EXPENSIVE
  6 hotter → COLDER
  7 the strongest → THE WEAKEST


⚠ 'PORSHE':

  Kitobda shunday yozilgan
  (to'g'risi Porsche).

My exercises were worse than yours. - No, they weren't. They were ___. (good)
He bought the cheapest computer on the market. - No, he didn't. He bought ___. (expensive)
The weather today is hotter than yesterday. - No, it isn't. It's ___. (cold)
Ann is the strongest girl I know. - No, she isn't. She's ___. (weak)

exercises.instructionEn: Put the adjectives in brackets into the correct form. Fill in than or the where necessary.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi sifatlarni to'g'ri shaklga qo'ying. Kerak bo'lsa than yoki the qo'shing.
exercises.explanationUz:
ShAKL + THAN / THE.

  1 SHORTER THAN my sister
  2 very CLEVER (oddiy)
  3 THE FASTEST train I've ever
    been on
  4 much HEAVIER THAN a guitar
  5 THE BEST restaurant
  6 MORE clothes THAN Casey
    (many → more)
  7 very EXPENSIVE (oddiy)
  8 CHEAPER THAN living in a house


⚠ 'JAKE'S':

  = Jake's restaurant (restoran
  nomi).

items.textEn: That is ___ train I've ever been on. (fast)
A piano is much ___ a guitar. (heavy)
Jake's is ___ restaurant in the city. (good)
Living in a flat is ___ living in a house. (cheap)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the following and answer the questions below. Jean has two sisters, Mandy and Susan, and two brothers, Pete and John. Mandy is sixteen. Susan is five years younger than Mandy but she is three years older than John. John is five years younger than Jean and he is six years younger than Pete.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagini o'qing va savollarga javob bering. Jinning ikki singlisi - Mendi va Syuzan, ikki akasi - Pit va Jon bor. Mendi 16 yoshda. Syuzan Mendidan 5 yosh kichik, lekin Jondan 3 yosh katta. Jon Jindan 5 yosh kichik va Pitdan 6 yosh kichik.
exercises.explanationUz:
YOSh MASALASI - HISOBLASh.

  Mandy = 16
  Susan = 16 - 5 = 11
  John = 11 - 3 = 8
  Jean = 8 + 5 = 13
  Pete = 8 + 6 = 14

  ENG KATTA: Mandy (16)
  ENG KIChIK: John (8)

  1 Jean - 13 (NAMUNA)
  2 No, Mandy is the oldest.
  3 No, Susan (11) is younger than
    Jean (13).
  4 John (8).
  5 Yes, Mandy (16) is older than
    Jean (13).


⚠ 'FIVE YEARS YOUNGER THAN':

  = ... dan 5 yosh kichik.

items.prompt: Jin necha yoshda? (Jon 8, Jin Jondan 5 yosh katta)
items.question: How old is Jean?
Is Pete the oldest in the family?
items.answer: No, he isn't. Mandy is the oldest.

items.question: Is Susan older than Jean?
items.answer: No, she isn't. Susan is younger than Jean.

items.question: Who is the youngest in the family?
items.answer: John is the youngest in the family.

items.question: Is Mandy older than Jean?
items.answer: Yes, she is. Mandy is older than Jean.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct form of the adjective in brackets.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni qavsdagi sifatning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ShAHAR va QIShLOQ - DIALOG.

  1 QUIETER than (than bor)
  2 very NOISY (oddiy)
  3 as INTERESTING as (oddiy)
  4 may be BORING (oddiy - 'may
    be' dan keyin qiyoslash yo'q)
  5 much MORE PEACEFUL (much →
    qiyosiy; uzun sifat)
  6 also HEALTHIER (qiyosiy -
    'also' avvalgi qiyoslashni
    davom ettiradi; 'healthy' ham
    qabul qilinadi)
  7 SAFER than


⚠ 'TO MOVE TO THE COUNTRY':

  = qishloqqa ko'chmoq ('the
  country' = qishloq joyi).


⚠ 'AT LEAST':

  = hech bo'lmaganda.

exercises.explanationUz:
QIYOSIY → (NOT) AS ... AS.

  X is better than Y →
  Y is NOT AS good AS X.

  Ikkalasi bir xil (both very hot)
  → X is AS hot AS Y.

  ⚠ 'as ... as' orasida sifat ODDIY
  shaklda!
  ⚠ 2-namuna: 'quicker' → 'as
  QUICKLY as' (ravish - fe'l
  'write' ni tasvirlaydi).

patterns.formula: X is + SIFAT-er than Y → Y is not as + SIFAT + as X
patterns.exampleEn: Dolphins are more intelligent than whales. → Whales are not as intelligent as dolphins.
patterns.exampleUz: Delfinlar kitlardan aqlliroq. → Kitlar delfinlardek aqlli emas.

patterns.exampleEn: Susan is five years younger than Mandy.
